title: 井中蜗牛
problem_statement_md:
蜗牛白天可以爬上7英尺，晚上滑落2英尺。
蜗牛需要多少天才能从给定深度的井中出来？
problem_statement_en_md:
[s0l0!-header][h1]The Snail in the Well[/h1][/s0l0!-header] 

The snail climbs up 7 feet each day and slips back 2 feet each night. 
How many days will it take the snail to get out of a well with the given depth?

[b]Sample Input: [/b]
31

[b]Sample Output:[/b]
6

[b]Explanation[/b]: Let's break down the distance the snail covers each day:
Day 1: 7-2=5
Day 2: 5+7-2=10
Day 3: 10+7-2=15
Day 4: 15+7-2=20
Day 5: 20+7-2=25
Day 6: 25+7=32 
So, on Day 6 the snail will reach 32 feet and get out of the well at day, without slipping back that night.
[note][b]Hint[/b]: You can use a loop to calculate the distance the snail covers each day, and break the loop when it reaches the desired distance.[/note]
hint_md: 可以用一个循环来计算蜗牛每天走过的距离，当它达到所需的距离时，就跳出循环。
